decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves long-cycle defense procurement contracts, where products stay in the portfolio for many years once qualified.
A spring-balanced desk lamp with its own product page suggests a design-oriented portfolio item meant to last beyond one year.
The newly launched G2 generation of an established interior luminaire family is a core product and very unlikely to be dropped within a year.
Pendant luminaires with microprismatic optics are a staple of office lighting and fit the firm's established business.
HMI searchlights face pressure from LED technology, but marine products have long service and certification cycles, so a drop within one year is still unlikely.
Marine searchlights are a niche specialty with stable demand and long lifecycles, so the firm will keep the product.
